text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I totally flubbed it out there, and
there's no
excuse for it. I got whooped,
plain 'n simple.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was puttin' my all into this,
but maybe
that wasn't enough...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Right. I did what I could, no doubt
about that.
choice_data_list: I gave it all the strength I have ...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But workin' so hard for this lousy result doesn't sit right with me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to shape up! Let's figure
out what
went wrong and make things
right next time for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll need some first-rate coachin' too!
'Cause the
next race is gonna be ours
and that's that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, Dad always said, "No matter
how hard
times get, ya gotta stay bright
and be strong."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to get some trainin' in!
I'm
gonna
start fresh 'n pump myself up all
over again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm never givin' up! I'm makin' first place my place next time!
